The '''''Star Breeze II''''' was a medium [[Transport/Legends|Transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to transport a group of refugees from [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to the Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|Safe world]] [[Kaliska]] some time after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Cloud Cover">{{GamerCite|3|Cloud Cover}}</ref>
